sentences.text:
Sanju vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:2756) on 17 January,
2024

[2024:RJ-JD:2756]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 7001/2023  Sanju W/o Kamlesh, Aged About 45 Years, R/o Ashuram C  Ward No. 60, Bhadwasiya P.s. Mata Ka Than, Dist. Jodh  --
 Versus  1. State Of Rajasthan, Through PP

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Harish Kumar S/o Babulal, R/o Mandir Wala Mohal  Bhawasiya, Dist. Jodhpur
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Sharwan Kumar, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 17/01/2024 1.

At the outset, learned Public Prosecutor submitted a detailed factual report dated 15.01.2024 sent by the SHO, Police Station Mata Ka Than, Jodhpur East, as per which, after thorough investigation,
the offence has been found proved against the accused Dheeraj Chouhan S/o shri Kamlesh Chouhan only for the offences under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471 of the IPC and accordingly, a charge-sheet has been filed in the Court on 06.01.2024.

entities.text: Police Station Mata Ka Than, Jodhpur East
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The name of the petitioner did not find place therein.

In this view of the matter, the instant criminal misc. petition as well as the stay petition are disposed of with direction to the Police to not to take any coercive action against the petitioner without prior permission of the trial Court.
2. The factual report be taken on record.

(FARJAND ALI),J 190-divya/-
